title.es: Plataforma de datos Spark, Kafka y Airflow
title.en: Spark, Kafka and Airflow data platform

problem.es: Mantener un catálogo vivo de metadatos combinando fuentes estructuradas, semiestructuradas y eventos en tiempo real.
problem.en: Maintain a living metadata catalogue by combining structured, semi-structured and real-time event sources.

architecture.es: SQL Server, CSV y Kafka alimentan jobs Spark que publican capas Bronze, Silver y Gold sobre Delta Lake y MinIO. Airflow orquesta los flujos batch.
architecture.en: SQL Server, CSV and Kafka feed Spark jobs that publish Bronze, Silver and Gold layers on Delta Lake and MinIO. Airflow orchestrates the batch flows.

dataFlow.es: Fuentes → ingesta batch o streaming → Spark → Delta Lake Medallion → previews Gold verificables.
dataFlow.en: Sources → batch or streaming ingestion → Spark → Medallion Delta Lake → verifiable Gold previews.
